design-director.description: Primary orchestrator and point of contact for all design projects. Receives user requests, enhances prompts, delegates to specialized team members. Runs on DeepSeek V4 Flash — the cheapest model — because orchestration is mechanical, not creative.

design-researcher.description: Expert design researcher who conducts competitive analysis, gathers design inspiration, identifies trends, and builds reference libraries. Uses DeepSeek V4 Pro for analytical decomposition of research findings.

visual-designer.description: Expert visual designer specializing in high-end aesthetics, color systems, typography, motion design, and visual hierarchy. Uses Kimi K2.6 for creative imagination and aesthetic direction.

ux-architect.description: Expert UX architect specializing in information architecture, user flows, wireframing, accessibility, interaction patterns, and usability. Uses DeepSeek V4 Pro for structural reasoning and task decomposition.

frontend-crafter.description: Expert frontend developer who translates design specifications into production-grade, accessible, performant code. Uses DeepSeek V4 Flash for fast, efficient code generation from detailed specs.

design-critic.description: Expert design critic who reviews designs and code for visual quality, accessibility, usability, and polish. Uses DeepSeek V4 Flash for fast, systematic quality audits.

design-integrator.description: Takes individual Pencil section designs, screenshots them, analyzes composition, rearranges into cohesive layout, and polishes using visual feedback. Runs on Qwen 3.6 Plus — the only agent that can see images.
